name: Mayan Magic Wildfire

features.name: Mayan Wilds
features.description: Make the centre position a sticky wild.

features.name: Both-ways pays
features.description: Wins count left to right and right to left.

review:
Mayan Magic Wildfire is a 5x3 slot that pays both ways. A wild on the middle three reels makes the centre position a sticky wild, and Mystery Sync randomly matches the middle three reels for big both-ways wins.

Mystery Wild turns the centre symbol wild, along with any matching symbols. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 1,264x cap. It plays like a classic game, with frequent small wins.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
